text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to visit Chrono Genesis
to check over the training menu—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Does your head hurt?
What's wrong? Does your head hurt?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The lineup for the upcoming exhibition race is so star-studded...
It looks like it's going to be a dream match across generations—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
How will this race unfold...
and who will ultimately take the win...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thoughts like that wouldn't stop racing through my head...
...The pain and dizziness... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems getting overly excited brought on a headache.
I decided to play it safe and let her rest for the day.
